source.licenseNote: CC0-1.0; upstream RX-24 geometry by Quaternius, Ultimate Guns Pack. The fixed source bytes stay unchanged.

semantics.primary-palm-center: Trigger-hand palm centre consumed by the live rifle view model; the primary hand contact point in root space, metres.
semantics.idle-support-palm-center: Support-hand palm centre in the idle two-hand hold, after hands() applies its single +0.025 m Y adjustment. This is the normal support foregrip hold.
semantics.reload-magazine-palm-target: Support palm target for the reload magazine grasp: support-palm.position + support-palm.gripOffset, i.e. source grip.surface + grip.palmOffset. This is the reload contact, not the idle foregrip hold.

derivation.idle-support-palm-center: weaponParts('rifle') part 'support-palm'.position (hands() Y adjustment already applied once)

muzzle.axisSource: Source scene extras declare up +Y / forward -Z as the weapon-group local axis; the muzzle node is a position-only anchor with no rotation, so the firing axis is the local -Z axis and no frame is derived from the point.

gripInterpretation: The source node named grip (extras.role support-palm-contact) is the reload-magazine palm target, not the idle support foregrip hold, a primary-hand grip, a generic bone socket or a camera mount. Its name and extras are unchanged.
